name: skills4paranoia
title_zh: 研究卡组每页必须挂回问题，代码审查专挑静默失败
tagline_zh: 你总说『先记下来』，结果笔记堆成山、代码跑得通却悄悄算错。这套 Skill 逼每张卡片回答『这页在解哪个问题』。
tagline_en: Tired of notes that pile up and code that runs but quietly lies? These skills force every card to name its.
desc_en: Agent skills that enforce the disciplines people skip. Research decks that must tie every page to a stated problem, and a VLA/WAM/RL code review that hunts the failures which never raise.
why_zh: 机制上反着来：不帮你多记，逼你少记——每页无主问题直接拒收；审查不查风格。
why_en: It flips the norm: not more notes but fewer—cards without a stated problem get rejected; review skips style to hunt silent.
limit_zh: 只覆盖研究笔记和 VLA/WAM/RL 代码审查两类；不生成笔记内容，只做关联性校验；审查需已有可运行代码与测试环境。
limit_en: Only for research notes and VLA/WAM/RL code review; no note generation, only linkage checks; review needs runnable code and test env, else static.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Research decks tied to problems; code review for silent.
